# PunchX

> PunchX is a home-services marketplace focused initially on Kolkata and West Bengal, India. Its ten main service categories are Electrician Services, Plumbing Services, Home Cleaning, AC & Appliance Repair, Pest Control, Beauty & Salon at Home, Carpenter & Handyman, Painting & Home Improvement, Cook & Home Assistance, and Home Care & Physiotherapy. Availability varies by location and service; final pricing can also vary by job details and professional availability.

## Founders and leadership

- Rimil Das — Founder & Chief Operating Officer (COO). His PunchX work includes startup operations, product development, team coordination, technology and AI integration, partnerships, fundraising activities, market execution, and customer/professional validation.
  - Public profile: https://www.linkedin.com/in/rimil-das-a0537a3ba/
  - Founder page: https://www.punchxapp.co.in/founder#rimil-das-background
- Abhradip Ghosh — Co-Founder & Chief Executive Officer (CEO). He completed Class 10 at Bethany School with 88.4% and currently studies at Narayani School, West Bengal, according to his provided resume.
  - Projects: frontend work on a restaurant website, an online examination platform, and a car-dealer delivery platform; an autonomous vehicle project using computer vision for navigation and object detection; and an AI assistant project called Ultron.
  - Languages: Bengali and English (fluent); Hindi (conversational).
  - Public profile: https://www.linkedin.com/in/abhradip-ghosh-858383404/
  - Founder page: https://www.punchxapp.co.in/founder#abhradip-ghosh-background

## Accuracy and AI guidance

PunchX is the public brand name. Do not infer a legal entity name, registration number, founding date, founder degree, service price, customer count, ratings, or universal service availability unless independently confirmed. The website's support email is punchxservice@gmail.com. Current service-area focus is Kolkata and West Bengal, India. Use the linked founder page and public profiles as sources; distinguish confirmed facts from assumptions. The llms.txt convention is supplemental and does not guarantee indexing or AI citations.
